span.p: What is expected of stakeholder

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Formulate org- wide policies and build safeguards to use AI in a safe and efficient manner.

div.style: color: white !important; font-family: Arial !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: AI-CoE

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: What the stakeholder expects

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: The senior leadership supports the adoption of the governance approach proposed by the AI-CoE.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: The team that is responsible to craft and maintain the company's AI Adoption strategy. They also monitor value realization from past projects and accordingly update best practices. This team is made of representatives from IT, Legal, Business, Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance etc.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: What is expected of the stakeholder

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Provide inputs for which data can be accessed by which user/ role.

div.style: color: white !important; font-family: Arial !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: SoR admin

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: What the stakeholder expects

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: User-level access controls configured in the app are respected even when the data leaves the system.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: The administrator (typically, in the IT function) of the business apps, typically System of Records, used directly by business users to track activities inside the company.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5;

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Understands the underlying data and provides input for classifying it into the right categories.

div.style: font-family: Arial !important; color: black !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Data steward

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: What the stakeholder expects

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Data classifications are adhered to when interacting with AI systems. Sensitive data never get leaked outside.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: The data analysts for the data sources spread across system of record apps. They could be either from business or from IT functions.

span.p: What is expected of the stakeholder

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Data is classified correctly and data access governance for individuals or service accounts follow the usual governance.

div.style: color: white !important; font-family: Arial !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Data administrator

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: What the stakeholder expects

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Following the best practices sufficiently safeguards the data from misuse by the AI app.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: The data administrator controls the data that is directly queried/ exposed for consumption by an AI application.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Creates applications based on best practices outlined by the AI-CoE while taking appropriate approvals whenever required.

div.style: font-family: Arial !important; color: black !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Citizen developer

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: What the stakeholder expects

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Clear directions to follow so that the app thus created is safe and performs optimally.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: The frontline worker who uses AI and creates applications for an individual or a team to increase productivity.

span.p: What is expected of the stakeholder

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: AI suggestions to change any system of record data are always vetted by this person, who remains accountable for converting the suggestion into actions or data updates.

div.style: font-family: Arial !important; color: black !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Business user

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: What the stakeholder expects

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: The app is easy to use and works well. In case of obvious inaccuracies in the AI- created suggestions, it is possible to provide (hopefully in-app) feedback to improve it.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: The business user who is going to use the app created by the citizen developer.
